_notes.siteUrl: Single source for every canonical, Open Graph, sitemap and structured-data URL. Override at build time with the SITE_URL environment variable. 'toolskit.com' is the domain used by earlier versions; it is NOT confirmed as owned. Set siteUrlConfirmed to true once it is.
_notes.urlStyle: 'html' keeps the existing .html URLs. 'clean' drops .html (Vercel cleanUrls). Same pages, no duplicates: canonicals and redirects follow this setting.
_notes.contactEmail: Leave empty until a real address exists. The Contact page then says so honestly instead of showing a fake form. Set it and rebuild to enable mailto links.
_notes.operatorName: Name of the person or organisation operating the site, shown in the Privacy Policy and Terms. Leave empty until known; do not invent one.
_notes.languages: Add a language only when its tools, errors and legal pages are fully translated. With more than one enabled language the header shows a language selector and pages emit hreflang.
